item.title: Saudi Arabia braces for coldest winter stretch as powerful weather system sets in
item.description: Saudi Arabia is expected to experience its coldest and most intense winter spell so far this season, as a deep low-pressure system moves across the region, according to the National Centre for Meteorology.
